title: Jennifer Lopez Makes Surprise Coachella Debut During David Guetta Set For ‘Save Me Tonight’: ‘The Most Fun Day!!’
summary: The singer popped out during Saturday's (April 12) set in a silver bodysuit during a break from her Las Vegas residency.
contentText:
Coachella has a well-earned reputation for surprise pop-ins and unannounced cameos, so it made perfect sense that Jennifer Lopez notched her festival debut on Saturday night (April 11) during David Guetta ‘s set with no prior warning. After all, the dynamic duo recently released their high-energy dance collab “ Save Me Tonight ” and JLo has a bit of rare free time since wrapping her Up All Night Live in Las Vegas residency at the Colosseum at Caesars Palace on March 28.

Lopez got fans super excited when she took the stage in a silver high-cut bodysuit (barely) covered by a feathery green jacket she quickly discarded. The singer/actress chronicled her big night in 90-second Instagram video , which opens with her exiting a private plane in a classic Coachella look: stacked leather boots, a leathery cowboy hat, white feathery jacket, long, flowery boho skirt and fringed leather purse.

After striking a few poses on the jetway, we see Lopez smiling backstage as Guetta tells the crowd, “I invited a friend! … Make some noise for Jennifer Lopez!” The scene then quickly cuts from Lopez waiting to hear her name, to a quick-change into her glittery stage outfit, a ride to the venue in an SUV and her iconic, windblown entrance for the first live performance of the song.

“Don’t know if it lasts forever, but it’s now or never,” Lopez sang as the crowd went wild, the beat bubbled up and a sea of phones popped into the air to capture the moment. “You could sa-a-a-ve me tonight/ DOn’t know where your touch could take me, but it feels like maybe/ You could sa-a-a-ve me tonight.” At one point, Lopez hopped up on a platform near Guetta’s decks and then dropped in front of it to whip her hair alongside dancers dressed in electric blue leotards.

“The most fun day!! ‘Save Me Tonight’ with David live for the first time at MY FIRST COACHELLA was so special,” Lopez wrote in the caption to her post. “My happy era is rewriting everything. Don’t ever stop surprising yourself 🤍”

Guetta also marked the moment, posting a highlight reel from his Quasar Stage set cued to his 2010 collab with Kid Cudi, “Memories,” featuring footage of Lopez performing and giving him a big hug at the end of their surprise set.

“Save Me Tonight” is Lopez’s first release since last year’s Kiss of the Spider-Woman soundtrack, which followed 2024’s This Is Me … Now . The song, her first collab with Guetta, was released on March 6 on What a DJ/ Warner Records and it debuted at No. 18 on the Hot Dance/Electronic Songs chart and No. 38 on Dance/Mix Show Airplay.

Lopez wasn’t the only one with a guest pass for the first weekend of Coachella. Karol G brought out Becky G for their collab “MAMIII,” Major Lazer’s set featured M.I.A. performing “Paper Planes,” Justin Bieber was joined by Tems and WizKid (“Essence”) and the Kid LAROI, Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker hopped on the kit for “Chains & Whips” and “P.O.V.” during the Clipse’s set, Camila Cabello popped out for “Havana” with Young Thug and the Smashing Pumpkins’ Billy Corgan dueted with sombr on his band’s “1979.”

In addition, Teddy Swims hit the trifecta with surprise guests Joe Jonas (“When You Look Me In the Eyes”), Vanessa Carlton (“A Thousand Miles”) and former Van Halen singer David Lee Roth (“Jump”), while KATSEYE were joined by the voices of Kpop Demon Hunters — EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami — for an amped up version of “Golden” and Sabrina Carpenter’s set featured cameos from Will Ferrell, Sam Elliott, Susan Sarandon and the singer’s former Girl Meets World cast mate Corey Fogelmanis, among many other weekend surprises.
